classification_vocabulary.meaning: A current product, runtime, authority, custody, continuity, publication, SDK, or governed service component whose behavior should carry a normalized component version.
Research, formalism, experiment, paper, observatory, or test corpus where artifact/schema/research versions may be more appropriate than a product component version.
Historical, superseded, duplicate, compatibility, mirror, migration, or legacy repository that must retain provenance but must not inflate the active component denominator.

Telemetry, manifests, metadata, receipts, registries, orchestration support, or other supporting surfaces that may require schema/data versioning without representing a standalone user-facing component release.

Organization control, policy metadata, GitHub configuration, repository standards, or ecosystem coordination surfaces whose version obligations are governance/schema based rather than product-release based.
Observed repository whose current role has not yet been reconciled against its mirror handoff and live state.

early_findings: legacy_core_lite must be evaluated as explicit MIRROR_LEGACY candidate rather than active component by name alone
core-lite and Data-Continuation/core-lite require authority/source reconciliation before either is counted in a full active denominator

StegVerse-Labs contains product/runtime repositories, research/publication repositories, control-plane repositories, telemetry, empty/bootstrap repositories, and domain-specific applications; one version obligation cannot truthfully apply to all of them
StegVerse-org/TV and StegVerse-org/TVC must be reconciled against StegVerse-Labs/TV and StegVerse-Labs/TVC before active-component counting
demo and telemetry/manifests surfaces require non-product classification unless their handoffs establish current product authority

completion_rule: Discovery completes only when all 11 installed accounts are enumerated from installation-backed repository lists, every observed repository is classified against its applicable mirror handoff/live state, duplicate/superseded authority is resolved, and the active-versioning denominator is emitted separately from research/schema/support/legacy inventories.
